verify.note: The default runs no hook, so the replay proves Enhanced, each recording whole: at every hook every register with R, all 48K RAM bar the sites and the dead stack, the clock and the MMU against the original; the back-buffer picture against a model that reads the set afresh, and the game's own buffer bit by bit; ABI cases on the first recording's states and 12 broken builds. Pace, soak, flicker and the real loader are in games/silkworm.md "Evidence".

status.title: Silkworm
